name: Alice
source: Slave from another world who's disgusted by her former master. She's treated like livestock because of her magic ability. Thinking sex is just for enjoyment she's happy to offer sex to her master whenever he wishes until [url=/c64060]Ayana[/url] explains that sex is a ceremony for making babies which makes her extremely angry at Kohei.
